# MilePost Zero: How to Name Your Brahmin

__Naming Your Brahmin for the First Time__

To name your Brahmin, first hire Josie the Brahmin Tamer, which will cost you 100 supplies. You don’t need to upgrade Josie to set or change your Brahmin's name.

Once Josie arrives, talk to her. You can select any options during the conversation, but eventually choose:

**"Hm. Listen, I better get going."**

Immediately speak to her again, and proceed with the following dialogue options.

**"How are you getting on with the Brahmin?"**

Josie will have a brief conversation with you, and then she'll ask if you want to name your Brahmin. When prompted, select:

**"How about..."**

Select the Brahmin Prefix (First Name) and Suffix (Last Name) from the pop-up screen.

__To change your Brahmin's name__

If you've already named your Brahmin and want to change it, interact with Josie and select:

**"I'd like to rename my Brahmin"**

Select the Brahmin Prefix (First Name) and Suffix (Last Name) from the pop-up screen.
